title: Central package version declared as a floating wildcard
description: Directory.Packages.props declares a `<PackageVersion>` value of `X.*`. The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a `<PackageVersion>` value of `X.*`.
remediation: Pin the declaration to an exact version or to the narrowest range the project tests, and update it deliberately. Specifically: fix a `<PackageVersion>` value of `X.*`.
limitation: It matches a `<PackageVersion>` value of `X.*` in the parsed Directory.Packages.props; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
